info:
The calculated status gets extracted from the message
and is then posted to mosquitto address:

>esp32/unit_(respective unit number)/status

to inform the ESP of the current calculated status.


The same status number gets sent to the "local" tab
to calculate the state of light to be lit up on the
local RasPi break-out panel.

name: Inputs
info:
Each unit calculation block takes in 5 inputs 
as arguments :

>Unit temperature measurement (ESP)
>Unit nominal value (GEM)
>E-stop signal (local)
>Unit humidity measurement (ESP)
>Humidity limits, nominal humidity (GEM)

First three are joined and are used for calculation 
in the "giga node". The latter two inputs are joined 
together to calculate humidity buzzer status.

name: Outputs
info:
The result of the "giga node" is parsed for the "status"
property, which is routed to ESP and local destinations
for processing.

The result of the "giga node" is then also combined with 
the humidity measurement, before being passed up to the 
GEM.

The Humidity reading is combined with humidity
limits (nominal humidity), based on which the buzzer
status is calculated (wether it should be on or off) and
is then passed down to the ESP.
